subject: Reasoning
topic: Direction & Distance — compass directions, distance tracking, relative positions

questions.stem: Ram starts from point A, walks 10 km north, then 5 km east, then 10 km south. How far is he from point A?
questions.explanation: Net displacement: North 10, South 10 → net vertical = 0. East 5 → net horizontal = 5. Straight-line distance from A = 5 km. Answer: A. Trap: adding distances (25 km) instead of net displacement.

questions.stem: From point X, A walks 3 km west, then 4 km north. B walks 4 km east, then 3 km north. After their walks, in which direction is B from A?
questions.explanation: A's position: 3 km west, 4 km north. B's position: 4 km east, 4 km north. Relative: B is (4 - (-3)) = 7 km east and (4 - 4) = 0 km north of A. Direction: East. Answer: A. Trap: confusing coordinate system or directions.

questions.stem: Priya walks 5 km south, then 3 km west, then 5 km north. In which direction is she from her starting point?
questions.explanation: Net: South 5, North 5 → vertical = 0. West 3 → horizontal = 3 west. Direction: West. Answer: A. Trap: confusing directions or miscalculating net.

questions.stem: If you travel 7 km north, then turn right (east) and travel 24 km. How far are you from the starting point (straight-line distance)?
questions.explanation: Position: 7 km north, 24 km east. Distance = √(7² + 24²) = √(49 + 576) = √625 = 25 km. Answer: C. Trap: adding distances or miscalculating Pythagorean theorem.

questions.stem: A man walks 5 km north, then turns left (west) and walks 5 km. What is his final direction from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Position: 5 km north, 5 km west. Distance ratio N:W = 1:1 → 45° angle northwest. Direction: Northwest. Answer: A. Trap: assuming pure north or west instead of diagonal.

questions.stem: From point O, P goes 6 km east, then 8 km north. Q goes 8 km west, then 6 km south. What is the distance between P and Q?
questions.explanation: P: 6 km east, 8 km north. Q: 8 km west, 6 km south. Difference: (6-(-8), 8-(-6)) = (14, 14). Distance = √(14² + 14²) = √(196+196) = √392 ≈ 19.8 ≈ 20 km. Answer: B. Trap: miscalculating vector differences or using wrong formula.

questions.stem: A runner starts facing north. He turns 90° clockwise, then 45° counterclockwise. In which direction is he facing?
questions.explanation: Initial: North (0°). Turn 90° clockwise: East (90°). Turn 45° counterclockwise: 90° - 45° = 45° from north (northeast or southeast?). At 45° from north moving clockwise is Southeast. Answer: C. Trap: confusing clockwise/counterclockwise or angle directions.
